stem.en: Two sound waves travel through the same air. In wave A, the density changes much more from the average than in wave B. Wave A has a frequency of 300 Hz, and wave B has a frequency of 900 Hz. Which statement is true?

text.en: Wave A is louder, and wave B has the higher pitch.
Wave B is louder, and wave B has the higher pitch.
Wave A is louder, and wave A has the higher pitch.
Both waves are equally loud, and wave B has the higher pitch.

explanation.en: Loudness goes with amplitude: wave A's density changes more, so it has the larger amplitude and is louder. Pitch goes with frequency: wave B has the higher frequency, 900 Hz, so it has the higher pitch.

hints.en: Which property sets the loudness, and which sets the pitch?
